generator: ChatGPT Image built-in tool (or any text-to-image tool that honors a chroma-key background)
_note: Same structure as CodeTank prompts.json, re-skinned to the Kiro ghost. To build one action sheet's prompt, concatenate canonical (as identity reference) + actionTemplate + the action line. Render each sheet in the manifest's grid order (left-to-right, top-to-bottom), one full mascot per equal cell, on a perfectly uniform #00ff00 background.

canonical.layout: eight evenly spaced full-body poses in a strict 4 columns by 2 rows layout
canonical.subject: the same AWS Kiro ghost: a rounded white-to-violet ghost with a smooth domed top, a gently scalloped wavy bottom hem, two glowing cyan visor eyes set close together, and a soft violet/cyan aura; no arms or legs unless an action needs a faint hint of hands
canonical.style: crisp hand-authored 16-bit-era pixel art, hard pixel clusters, limited palette, no antialiasing, no soft gradients on the outline
canonical.poses: front, three-quarter, side, back, happy, thinking, floating-still, drifting
canonical.constraints: perfectly uniform #00ff00 chroma-key background; no shadow, gradient, texture, floor, text, labels, watermark, border, grid lines or green pixels on the ghost itself

actionTemplate.identity: Use canonical-reference.png as Image 1 and preserve the exact ghost silhouette, visor eyes, proportions, violet body, cyan glow, scale and palette.
actionTemplate.layout: Arrange frames in manifest grid order, left-to-right then top-to-bottom, one complete mascot in each equal cell with a consistent baseline (bottom hem line).
actionTemplate.background: Use a perfectly uniform #00ff00 background with no shadow, gradient, texture, floor plane or lighting variation.
actionTemplate.constraints: No text, labels, watermark, dividers, extra characters, cropped body parts, realistic shading, soft edges, costume changes or camera changes.

actions.idle: gentle float bob and a slow blink of the cyan visor eyes, hem waving softly, returning to the first pose
actions.alert: visor eyes widen and flash brighter cyan, a small startled upward pop with compact amber alert pixels, then settle
actions.happy: eyes curve into a smile, a joyful upward bounce with restrained cyan/violet sparkles, then settle
actions.sleeping: droop lower, eyes dim to a thin cyan line, slow breathing float and tiny cyan sleep bubbles without letter glyphs
actions.disconnected: eyes flicker and the aura weakens as it inspects a compact dark network glyph, hem sags, then recovers
actions.thinking: tilt slightly, one faint hint of a hand near the top, look upward as a tiny cyan thought sparkle appears and fades
actions.typing: hover behind one compact dark keyboard, faint hands alternate rapidly and the visor pulses tiny cyan indicator pixels
actions.juggling: juggle exactly three small code-orbs in cyan, violet and pale white along a clear circular arc
actions.building: assemble three dark geometric code blocks on a compact workbench and light their cyan edges
actions.confused: drift left and right, tilt, and orbit a few abstract cyan/amber question pixels above the dome
actions.dizzy: sway with abstract spiral highlights in the visor and three tiny orbiting cyan/violet stars
actions.sweeping: sweep small gray/cyan pixel fragments into a neat pile using one consistent compact broom
actions.walking: right-facing in-place drift cycle with subtle bob across two steps (a floating ghost 'walk')
actions.going_away: wave a faint hand, drift briskly right and dissolve into a compact cyan pixel trail as a one-shot
actions.debugger: hold one compact magnifying glass, follow dark blocks and find one amber bug cluster
actions.wizard: raise a dark cyan-tipped wand, float higher, trace cyan/violet pixels and form a small portal ring
actions.conducting: coordinate a beat with one dark cyan-tipped baton while three cyan data-orbs respond
actions.beacon: tap one dark handheld antenna beacon as cyan signal arcs expand and an amber acknowledgement flashes
